subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should Mattermost cold-thread recovery intentionally delay the first inbound turn by up to the fetch timeout and suppress every retry for that stored session after any failed attempt?
rationale: Tests establish the implementation behavior, but they cannot choose the user-facing tradeoff between bounded inbound availability, recovery from transient server failures, and avoiding repeated thread requests.

options.title: Retain one-attempt recovery
options.body: Clamp requests to 200 and keep one bounded attempt per stored session, accepting that transient failures require a session rotation before recovery is retried.

options.title: Add bounded transient retries
options.body: Retry only transient failures after a cooldown or small attempt budget while preserving the per-thread in-flight guard and hard timeout.

options.title: Pause the backfill change
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged until an asynchronous or otherwise non-blocking recovery design is agreed.

recommendation.title: Retain one-attempt recovery
recommendation.body: Clamp requests to 200 and keep one bounded attempt per stored session, accepting that transient failures require a session rotation before recovery is retried.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this handle with the Mattermost area, making them the best available owner for the channel-specific availability and recovery policy.
